title: Studio by Insyd
tagline: A dark, glyph-rendered product reveal: decode captions, a monitor drop and a flight through the feature set.
description: The launch film for Studio by Insyd. Words are built from glyphs over a rolling character-art terrain, questions decode out of noise, a search bar types itself, and on the drop a monitor reads INTRODUCING… before the camera flies into the product. A constellation of feature panels, a wall of templates and a logo that lands on the final hit close it out — cut to an original 120 BPM score with every sound effect on the timeline.
author: Insyd
